# Aditya Gaur, Advocate

Professional legal representation across Faridabad, Delhi NCR and Pan-India. Chamber opposite the District & Sessions Court, Faridabad, Haryana – 121002. Matters before District Courts, High Courts and the Supreme Court of India, subject to jurisdiction.

## What this site offers
- Practice areas: criminal defence, bail and anticipatory bail, FIR quashing, divorce and family law, maintenance and child custody, property and civil disputes, RERA, cheque bounce (Section 138 NI Act), debt recovery, corporate and commercial law, contracts and agreements.
- Location pages for Faridabad, Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Gurugram, Delhi NCR and Pan-India matters.
- Courts & jurisdiction overview.
- Legal Insights articles on Indian legal procedures.
- Consultation enquiry form and chamber contact details.
